subject.title: fix(mattermost): cap opaque, outbound, and monitor resource caches

question: After real behavior proof is supplied, should this broader Mattermost cache-cap PR be the canonical landing path over the outbound-only PR?
rationale: Two open same-author PRs change overlapping Mattermost send caches with different caps and test coverage; automation should not choose the final cap table or canonical scope for maintainers.

options.title: Use the broader PR after proof
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical fix if the contributor adds real Mattermost/gateway proof and the outbound cap values/test coverage are acceptable.

options.title: Use the outbound-only PR plus follow-up
options.body: Land the narrower outbound PR and ask for a separate monitor/opaque-cache PR if maintainers want smaller review units.

options.title: Pause both PRs
options.body: Keep both PRs blocked until maintainers choose a cap policy and required proof standard for Mattermost runtime caches.

recommendation.title: Use the broader PR after proof
recommendation.body: Treat this PR as the canonical fix if the contributor adds real Mattermost/gateway proof and the outbound cap values/test coverage are acceptable.
